about_the_game:
Build a tiny pixel city that grows by itself. Place buildings to increase your brick production, unlock new structures, and watch your miniature world bustle with people, cars, and buses as it expands. It’s a calm, incremental city builder where your town keeps working even when you take a break.

Key Features

  • Relaxing Incremental Gameplay
    Place buildings and watch your brick production climb as your city becomes more efficient.

  • Cozy Pixel City
    Tiny people wander the streets, vehicles pass by, and the world comes to life as you expand.

  • Click or Idle — Your Choice
    Click to boost early progress, or simply let your buildings generate resources over time.

  • Upgrade & Expand
    Unlock stronger buildings, production boosters, and late-game structures to push your city further.

  • Prestige & Rebuild
    Complete your Monument to restart with a permanent global bonus, making each new run faster and more rewarding.

  • Stress-Free City Building
    No losing, no timers, no pressure — just steady progress and a satisfying growth curve.
